title: OptionNotListed
description: master.option_not_listed r1: a contract IBKR answered none for, remembered until retry_at.

strike.description: Strike as text, as in the key of the contract.

right.description: P for a put, C for a call.

retry_at.description: Instant from which the contract may be asked again: checked_at plus 7 days plus a jitter of minus 2 to plus 2 days.

error_code.description: Error code of the answer; null for an empty list.

error_text.description: Error text of the answer; null for an empty list.
